Tutorial.title: Welcome to Todo
Tutorial.description: You can clear this message by clicking "remove" on the bottom left of your screen

Tutorial.title: Add tasks
Tutorial.description: Click the "add" button to add a new task. You can also press enter after typing the title in the input field.

Tutorial.title: Edit tasks
Tutorial.description: Select a task and click the "edit" button to edit it. You can change the title, description and priority.

Tutorial.title: Complete tasks
Tutorial.description: Select a task and click the "complete" button to mark it as completed. Completed tasks will be greyed out.

Tutorial.title: Remove tasks
Tutorial.description: Select a task and click the "remove" button to delete it permanently.
